findings.oracle: PEP 695 `def _run[T](...)` is valid: project floor is requires-python >= 3.13 (verified in pyproject.toml); helper now documents this and runs every coroutine on a fresh, closed-per-call event loop so results are deterministic and order-independent. Confirmed by the suite executing under Python 3.13.13.

Real initialized HexEditorBridge with document=None and a populated sandbox_registry; asserts type(exc) is RuntimeError and str(exc) == 'no document open' (exact, not substring match). Boundary: an independently built bridge with a real PE document open and the same registry moves PAST the guard and raises ToolError 'Invalid sandbox_type: \'no-such-type\'', proving the guard keys on document absence, not an unrelated condition.

Real loaded_bridge (PE document open) with tool_registry set to None; asserts type(exc) is RuntimeError and str(exc) == 'tool registry not set; cannot access sandbox bridge' (exact). Boundary: after set_tool_registry(sandbox_registry) the guard no longer fires and the call reaches SandboxBridge.create which raises ToolError 'Invalid sandbox_type: \'no-such-type\'', proving the guard keys on tool_registry is None.

Real empty ToolRegistry; test asserts empty_registry.get(ToolName.SANDBOX) is None first to prove the genuine cross-bridge lookup path is taken, then asserts type(exc) is RuntimeError and str(exc) == 'sandbox bridge not available' (exact). Boundary: a registry holding a real SandboxBridge returns a live bridge from the same get(ToolName.SANDBOX) lookup, the guard does NOT fire, and the call proceeds into SandboxBridge.create raising ToolError 'Invalid sandbox_type: \'no-such-type\''.
